'''Roland Sakowski ISB Invading Endor''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Roland Sakowski]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6501">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6501 ISB Invading Endor], DeckTech (Roland "I_Vader" Sakowski, 9 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6501/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6501/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018172254/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6501/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Roland Sakowski]]
* '''Published:''' 9 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ISB Invading Endor''

== Original post ==

'''ISB Invading Endor'''
* '''Author:''' Roland "I_Vader" Sakowski
* '''Published:''' May 9, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' HUGE drains, goob fighting, and ok destiny.

=== Strategy ===

Just drain, draw, and fight.  The deck has HUGE drains, and a great fighting ability.	It cancels alot of stuff and kills the opponent while he is setting up
